fields.Name: T082 - Open Saved View In New Tab
fields.Description: Exercises the view-as-resource-tab navigation path (OpenViewInTabRequested), distinct from opening a record tab and from selecting a view in place.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Products', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Open the saved-view selector (layer-group icon). On a listed view card (or the '(Default)' entry once selected) use the 'Open in Tab' action (an external-link / up-right-from-square icon on the view card, or the icon button next to the selector). Success is the view opening as its own workspace tab/resource. Seeing the view open as a distinct tab is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: An 'Open in Tab' control (external-link icon) is available for a view in the selector
Activating it opens the view as its own tab/resource showing the entity's records (or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
